steps.text: Factor the numerator and the denominator completely.

steps.text: The denominator cannot be zero: solve D(x) = 0 to find the excluded values.

The degree of the numerator is one more than the degree of the denominator, so there is an oblique (slant) asymptote and no horizontal asymptote. Use long division.
Divide the leading terms, multiply back, subtract; repeat.
Result of the division (quotient + remainder/divisor).
Check: divisor × quotient + remainder gives back the numerator.
As x → ±∞ the remainder fraction → 0, so the graph approaches the quotient line.

learning_outcomes.title: Graph exponential growth functions
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: For y=a·bˣ with b>1 the graph rises, passes through (0,a) and has the x-axis as asymptote.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: للدالة y=a·bˣ مع b>1 يرتفع المنحنى ويمر بالنقطة (0,a) ومحور السينات خط تقارب.

learning_outcomes.title: Solve exponential inequalities
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Write both sides with the same base, then compare exponents (reverse the sign if 0<b<1).
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: اكتب الطرفين بالأساس نفسه ثم قارن الأسس (اعكس الإشارة إذا كان 0<b<1).

learning_outcomes.title: Convert exponential and logarithmic forms
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: log_b a = c ⇔ bᶜ = a (b>0, b≠1, a>0).
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: log_b a = c ⇔ bᶜ = a (b>0، b≠1، a>0).

learning_outcomes.title: Solve logarithmic equations using properties
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Use log a + log b = log(ab), log a − log b = log(a/b), log aⁿ = n·log a, then remove the logs and check the domain.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: استخدم خصائص اللوغاريتم لدمج الحدود ثم أزل اللوغاريتم وتحقق من المجال.

learning_outcomes.title: Change of base formula
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: log_b a = log a / log b = ln a / ln b.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: log_b a = log a / log b = ln a / ln b.

learning_outcomes.title: Natural base and natural logarithms
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: ln x is log base e; ln eˣ = x and e^(ln x) = x.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: ln x لوغاريتم الأساس e؛ ln eˣ = x وe^(ln x) = x.

learning_outcomes.title: Simplify rational expressions
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Factor numerator and denominator, cancel common factors, and state excluded values.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: حلّل البسط والمقام واختصر العوامل المشتركة وبيّن القيم المستثناة.

learning_outcomes.title: Simplify complex algebraic fractions
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Multiply numerator and denominator by the LCD of all inner fractions.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: اضرب البسط والمقام في المضاعف المشترك الأصغر لمقامات الكسور الداخلية.

learning_outcomes.title: Transformations of reciprocal functions
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: y = a/(x−h) + k: asymptotes x=h and y=k; a stretches/reflects.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: y = a/(x−h) + k: خطا التقارب x=h وy=k؛ والمعامل a يمدّد/يعكس.

learning_outcomes.title: Solve rational equations
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Multiply by the LCD, solve, then reject any root that makes a denominator zero.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: اضرب في المضاعف المشترك الأصغر وحل ثم استبعد أي جذر يجعل المقام صفراً.

learning_outcomes.title: Classify types of statistical studies
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Survey, observational study, experiment (treatments imposed), simulation: decide who assigns the treatment.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: مسح، دراسة رصدية، تجربة (تُفرض المعالجة)، محاكاة: حدّد من يُعيّن المعالجة.

learning_outcomes.title: Experimental and theoretical probabilities
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Experimental = successes ÷ trials; theoretical = favourable outcomes ÷ all equally likely outcomes.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: التجريبي = عدد النجاحات ÷ عدد المحاولات؛ النظري = النواتج المرغوبة ÷ جميع النواتج المتساوية.

learning_outcomes.title: Design probability simulations
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Assign digits so the simulated chances match the real probabilities, then repeat many trials.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: وزّع الأرقام بحيث تطابق الاحتمالات المحاكاة ثم كرّر التجربة مرات كثيرة.

learning_outcomes.title: Distribution: center, spread and shape
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Describe centre (mean/median), spread (range, IQR, SD) and shape (symmetric, skewed).
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: صف المركز (الوسط/الوسيط) والتشتت (المدى، IQR، الانحراف) والشكل (متماثل، ملتو).

learning_outcomes.title: Angles in standard position
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Standard position: vertex at the origin, initial side on the positive x-axis; coterminal angles differ by 360°.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: الوضع القياسي: الرأس عند الأصل والضلع الابتدائي على محور السينات الموجب؛ الزوايا المشتركة تختلف بمضاعفات 360°.

learning_outcomes.title: Values of trigonometric ratios
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Use the reference angle and the quadrant to find the value and sign of sin, cos, tan.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: استخدم الزاوية المرجعية والربع لإيجاد قيمة وإشارة sin وcos وtan.

learning_outcomes.title: Properties of periodic functions
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Period, amplitude and midline: A = (max−min)/2, midline = (max+min)/2.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: الدورة والسعة وخط المنتصف: السعة = (أكبر−أصغر)/2، وخط المنتصف = (أكبر+أصغر)/2.

learning_outcomes.title: Applications of sinusoidal functions
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Model with y = A sin(B(x−C)) + D; period = 2π/B.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: النمذجة y = A sin(B(x−C)) + D؛ الدورة = 2π/B.

learning_outcomes.title: Other trigonometric functions
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: csc = 1/sin, sec = 1/cos, cot = 1/tan; tan = sin/cos.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: csc = 1/sin وsec = 1/cos وcot = 1/tan؛ وtan = sin/cos.

learning_outcomes.title: Inverse trigonometric functions
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: sin⁻¹, cos⁻¹, tan⁻¹ return an angle in the principal range: [−90°,90°], [0°,180°], (−90°,90°).
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: تعيد sin⁻¹ وcos⁻¹ وtan⁻¹ زاوية في المدى الأساسي: [−90°،90°] و[0°،180°] و(−90°،90°).

learning_outcomes.title: Evaluate expressions involving the natural base and logarithms
learning_outcomes.statement: Evaluate expressions involving the natural base and logarithms
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Domain of eˣ is ℝ, range (0,∞); average rate of change = (f(b)−f(a))/(b−a).
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: مجال eˣ هو ℝ ومداها (0,∞)؛ متوسط التغير = (f(b)−f(a))/(b−a).

learning_outcomes.title: Exponential growth and decay using logarithms
learning_outcomes.statement: Exponential growth and decay using logarithms
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Half-life T: k = ln 2 / T and y = a·e^(−kt).
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: نصف العمر T: k = ln 2 / T وy = a·e^(−kt).

learning_outcomes.title: Rational functions: oblique asymptotes and holes
learning_outcomes.statement: Rational functions: oblique asymptotes and holes
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Divide when deg(top) = deg(bottom)+1 to get the oblique asymptote; a cancelled factor gives a hole.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: اقسم عندما درجة البسط = درجة المقام + 1 لإيجاد المقارب المائل؛ العامل المختصر يعطي ثقباً.

learning_outcomes.title: Normal probabilities, areas and inverse values
learning_outcomes.statement: Normal probabilities, areas and inverse values
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: z = (x−μ)/σ; use the table or normalcdf; Empirical Rule 68–95–99.7.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: z = (x−μ)/σ؛ استخدم الجدول أو التوزيع الطبيعي؛ القاعدة التجريبية 68–95–99.7.

learning_outcomes.title: Degrees, radians, arc length and phase shifts
learning_outcomes.title_ar: الدرجات والراديان وطول القوس وإزاحة الطور
learning_outcomes.statement: Degrees, radians, arc length and phase shifts
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Arc length s = rθ (θ in radians); π rad = 180°; phase shift = C in A sin(B(x−C)).
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: طول القوس s = rθ (θ بالراديان)؛ π راديان = 180°؛ إزاحة الطور = C في A sin(B(x−C)).
